newsitem.title: USA: Tosco cat cracker at "over 50 pct" output - source.
newsitem.headline: Tosco cat cracker at "over 50 pct" output - source.

text.p: A downed fluid catalytic cracker at Tosco Corp's Bayway refinery in New Jersey has returned to "over 50 percent of its usual output," a source familiar with the refinery operations told Reuters Monday.
The giant 140,000 barrel per day cracker was put out of action Wednesday night after a small fire at the unit's relief valve and was tested last Friday for a possible return to operation.
"It's continuing to ramp up production and is running along well," the source said.
"It should be at full production levels in a few days and its output is high enough now that it shouldn't be a market factor" on prices, the source said.
The plant near Linden, N.J., the largest refinery on the East Coast, is a key supplier to the gasoline-starved region which only produces a third of what it consumes each day.
Differentials on New York Harbor conventional unleaded gasoline were stable late Monday with those of last Friday, with offers at about 1.25 cents under January futures.
But diffs on NYH reformulated "A5" grade material firmed about 0.10 cent to about 1.30 cents over the print, traders said.
((-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
